Research foundation

Why the check starts with work

01

AI changes tasks unevenly

Exposure to AI is not the same as job loss. The more useful management question is which tasks will be transformed, supported or retained.

02

Human accountability still matters

Where decisions affect people, safety, quality or material business outcomes, human authority must be clear and meaningful.

03

Skills-based hiring starts before advertising

Removing a degree requirement is not enough. The role, evidence and assessment method must reflect the work that actually needs to be done.

Evidence and limitations

This tool is distilled from Next Generation’s 2026 research into the future design of talent attraction and work. The underlying synthesis reviewed 75 sources, including task-level research from the International Labour Organization and risk-management guidance from NIST.

The assessment is a structured management prompt, not a validated psychometric instrument, legal opinion or prediction of workforce displacement. Its purpose is to improve the questions asked before a role decision is made.
